中文

体验优化
- `audit --clean-stale` 一次 flock+awk 批量改写全部 stale 行(N 行 = 1 次 ssh 往返),保持 mktemp + 原地写语义(gawk/mawk 双实测)
- 本地端口耗尽诊断:整个区间只跑一次 netstat + 一次 tasklist(POSIX 一次 lsof),不再每端口起进程
- peer/dev 依赖对齐 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cmdline ^0.1.2-alpha.3`,当前 harness alpha 下不再有 UNMET PEER 警告

其他变更
- npm 包不再携带 `test/`;新增英文版登记表格式文档;精简 README 过时排障行

English

Improvements
- `audit --clean-stale` rewrites every stale row in one flock+awk pass (N rows = one ssh round-trip), keeping the mktemp + in-place write semantics (verified on gawk and mawk)
- Local port-exhaustion diagnostics use one netstat + one tasklist (or one lsof) for the whole range instead of a spawn per port
- Peer/dev aligned to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cmdline ^0.1.2-alpha.3` — no more UNMET PEER warning on current harness alphas

Chores
- `test/` no longer shipped in the npm package; added an English registry-format doc; refreshed an outdated README troubleshooting row
